name: Dattebayo
source: What if Kara succeeded in its plan to revive Isshiki Otsutsuki using the power of the Divine Tree? How would the Hokage and Sasuke protect the Shinobi world?"
translation: What if Kara succeeded in its plan to revive Isshiki Otsutsuki using the power of the Divine Tree? How would the Hokage and Sasuke protect the Shinobi world?"
